meta.description: Websites and apps for small businesses.

hero.title: Hi, I'm Ville Syrjälä.
hero.lead: I build websites and apps, and I'm starting to build them for businesses too.

featured.heading: What I'm building
featured.title: My own music streaming service
featured.description: A browser-based music app for my own music library: player, queue, and browsing by artist and album. It runs on Navidrome as the backend, built so that it can later be swapped for my own.

services.heading: Services for businesses

items.title: Websites
items.description: A clear website for your business. It works well on phones and computers, and it's easy to update later.

items.title: Maintenance and updates
items.description: I keep your site up to date and secure. Includes up to one hour of small changes per month, such as updating text or images. Additional work billed by the hour.

items.title: Apps and automations
items.description: Small apps and automations that handle repetitive tasks for you, such as forms or moving data from one system to another.

services.ctaText: Tell me what you need, and I'll send you a quote.

contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.text: Tell me briefly what you need, and I'll get back to you within 1-2 days.
